battle.name: 和尚原之戰
battle.brief: 紹興元年（一一三一年）金軍進逼四川，和尚原成關中入蜀咽喉。宋將吳玠收散兵數千，依岩壁為壘，以弓弩結「弩陣」輪番射擊；十月完顏宗弼集兵數萬、渡澠水自寶雞連營三十里，三日激戰後疲退遭伏，宗弼中兩箭，宋軍俘金軍千餘人。十字弩的定點強射，是這場以險制騎之戰的主因。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 交戰雙方是女真金國與南宋的陝西防區。金方由完顏宗弼（兀朮）總攝，分兵兩路自關中東、西兩面壓向蜀道：紹興元年三月，沛立自同州入商州，五月出鳳翔，與烏鶻、折合兩將分兵並進，一出大散關、一趨和尚原；十月，完顏宗弼自統大軍，集兵數萬，架浮橋渡過澠水，自寶雞連營三十里，直撲入川關口。金軍編制以女真、渤海、契丹、漢軍混編為一部，馬兵居中為主力，步卒分列兩翼，糧秣則徵之於沿途州縣，就地取給。金廷的打算是在江南受挫之後改走西線，迂迴入蜀，切斷南宋朝廷與蜀中的聯繫。宋方主體是陝西四路的邊軍，朝廷以張浚攝川陝宣撫使節制關中與蜀口兩處兵馬，但真正頂在前線的是吳玠、吳璘兄弟：吳玠官居忠州防禦使，吳璘為關西宣贊舍人，其下有中州防禦使楊政所部，以及收攏來的散兵與西北舊卒，總數不過數千；漢中、興州一線的守軍與川口各寨的屯兵，則作為縱深與糧秣的來源。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Jurchen Jin state and the Song frontier force in Shaanxi. On the Jin side the operation was directed by Wanyan Zongbi (Wuzhu), with troops pressing on the road into Sichuan from two sides of the Guanzhong basin. In the third month of the first year of Shaoxing Peili came in through Shangzhou; in the fifth month he moved out from Fengxiang and joined Wuhu and Zhehe, who marched in two separate columns, one of them out through Dasan Pass and the other toward Hanchengyuan. In the tenth month Wanyan Zongbi took command of the great host in person, gathered tens of thousands of men, threw a floating bridge across the Min river and strung his camp out for thirty li from Baoji, driving straight at the mouth of the road into Sichuan. The Jin host was a mixed column of Jurchen, Bohai, Khitan and Han troops, with the horse in the middle as the main strength and the foot on the wings, and it drew its grain and supplies from the prefectures and counties along the route, taking them where it stood. The Jin court's plan was to turn to the western line after being checked in the south of the river, to go round into Sichuan by the back road and cut the Southern Song court off from the Shu. The Song side was the frontier garrisons of the four circuits of Shaanxi. The court gave Zhang Jun the acting command over Sichuan and Shaanxi, with authority over both the troops in Guanzhong and those at the mouth of the Sichuan roads, but the men actually in contact were those of the brothers Wu Jie and Wu Lin: Wu Jie held the rank of Defender of Zhong Prefecture and Wu Lin that of Assistant Officer of the Western Commission. Under them came the troops of Yang Zheng, Defender of Zhongzhou, together with the scattered soldiers and old troops of the northwest who had been gathered in, a few thousand men in all; the garrisons on the Hanzhong and Xingzhou lines and the camps at the mouth of the Sichuan roads served as the depth of the position and as the source of grain.
people: 關鍵人物分屬兩方。宋方的主將是吳玠。紹興元年他奉命收拾散兵，退守扼守蜀道的要隘與和尚原，有人勸他移屯漢中，他斷然拒絕，理由說得很清楚：「我保此，寧決不敗越我而進！」——此處可以壘壁固守，敵人就算越過去也算計不到後方，所以守住這裡便是守住蜀地。他的弟弟吳璘是關西宣贊舍人，與兄同守關隘；這一時期吳璘以事誣陷川陝名將曲端，曲端下獄被殺，宋方在關中喪失了一位熟悉山川地勢的老將，這道樁帳後來也成為吳氏兄弟之間的裂痕。張浚以攝川陝宣撫使的身分在後方調度，人在荊楚，距關中數千里，臨機決斷難以及時下達。金方最關鍵的人是完顏宗弼：十月他自統大軍打到寶雞，在和尚原折了兩箭，敗退回營。三月首攻受挫的是沛立，迂迴包抄的是烏鶻與折合，箭箙關一線則由楊政頂住。撤退時金軍被俘千餘人，宗弼的姻親猛帶也在其中。
peopleEn: The decisive figures stand on both sides. The Song commander was Wu Jie. In the first year of Shaoxing he was ordered to gather up the scattered soldiers and to hold the key passes of the road into Sichuan together with Hanchengyuan; when others urged him to move back to Hanzhong he refused outright, and gave his reason plainly: 'I hold this place; I would rather be destroyed than let them pass me and go on.' By walling himself in, even if the enemy came through, they could not work out what lay behind it, and so to hold this spot was to hold Sichuan. His brother Wu Lin, Assistant Officer of the Western Commission, held the passes with him. In this same period Wu Lin charged Qu Duan, one of the famed commanders of the Sichuan and Shaanxi region, with treason; Qu Duan was thrown into prison and put to death, and the Song lost at the front in Guanzhong a veteran who knew the mountains and the roads of the country. That grievance later became a rift between the two brothers. Zhang Jun, acting Commissioner of the Sichuan and Shaanxi circuits, directed the theatre from the rear, but he was in Jingchu, thousands of li from the front, and decisions could not reach the line in time. The key Jin figure was Wanyan Zongbi: in the tenth month he led the great host to Baoji, took two arrows at Hanchengyuan and had to break off. Peili had led the first attack in the third month, Wuhu and Zhehe carried out the turning movement, and the line at Jianfumen was held by Yang Zheng. In the retreat more than a thousand Jin men were taken, and among the prisoners was Mengdai, the man who had married into Zongbi's family.
kits: 卡面這件十字弩在這場戰爭裡的位置，是宋軍在關隘上最可靠的一種定點火力。吳玠守和尚原，基本手法就是依傍巖壁為壘：不設退路，把營壘直接貼在山岩與官道的交會處，前排以長槍、大刀與盾牌結陣抵擋，後排以弓弩壓制。弩在這裡比弓吃重：弩機、弩弦與箭筍固定成形，矢出之後破甲殺傷遠勝手開之弓，士卒可以在窄道裡以數十步的近距精確射擊；代價是裝填慢，一床弩從上弦到擊發要十幾息，因此宋軍只能輪番射，把十數床弩排成一列，前列擊發、後列上弦，箭雨密而不絕。史載宋軍以勁弓強弩輪番射擊，密如雨注，形成後人所稱的「弩陣」。《武經總要》所繪的步弩、神臂弓，正是這一時期宋軍弩兵的標準裝備，弩矢自有限的角度覆蓋通往營壘的每一條小道。金方則靠馬甲弓箭與工程取勝：女真重騎人馬皆甲，佩強弓大箭，逼近前列放箭；為渡澠水架設浮橋，把大軍連成三十里長營；營中備粟、芻草、挽馬與車，糧秣線一斷，數萬人的長營立刻變成最重的負擔。攻城器械在此役並無多少用武之地，和尚原關隘依山而設，雲梯與撞竿無所施其技，真正發揮作用的，仍是弩陣與糧道。
kitsEn: The crossbow on the card stood in this war as the most reliable kind of fixed fire for the Song army at a mountain pass. The way Wu Jie held Hanchengyuan was in principle to build the camp against the rock: no line of retreat, the rampart put directly against the meeting of the cliff and the official road, the front rank closed in with spear, sabre and shield to hold the enemy, and the rear rank pressing with bow and crossbow. The crossbow outweighed the bow here. Its lock, string and bolt are fixed in shape, and once the bolt is away it pierces and kills far better than a hand-loosed arrow, so a man can shoot with exact aim at short range of a few dozen paces even in a narrow lane; the price is the slow reload, for a single crossbow needs a dozen breaths or more between cocking and loosing, and so the Song could only shoot in relays, setting a dozen or more crossbows in a line, the front rank firing while the rear rank cocked, so that the arrows came thick and without a break. The record says the Song used strong bows and heavy crossbows in relays, shooting so dense it was like rain, and this is what came to be called the crossbow line. The foot crossbow and the divine-arm bow drawn in diagram in the Wujing Zongyao were the standard kit of the Song crossbowmen of this period, and their bolts covered, from a limited angle, every little path that led up to the camp. The Jin went the other way, relying on armoured horse, bow and engineering: the Jurchen heavy cavalry were armoured in man and horse and carried strong bows with long arrows, loosing them from just in front of the enemy line; to cross the Min they threw a floating bridge and drew the great host out into a camp thirty li long; and in that camp they carried millet, fodder, draught horses and carts, so that once the supply line was cut the long camp of tens of thousands became the heaviest thing of all. Siege machines had little room to work in this action: the passes at Hanchengyuan were taken from the mountain and there was nothing for ladders or rams to work upon. What really decided the matter was still the crossbow line and the supply line.
tactics: 和尚原一線的地理決定了打法。這條路自大散關、虛縣通向和尚原，是關中入蜀的門戶，官道狹窄，多怪石壁立，兩側是陡坡與深谷，騎兵在此寸步難行，金軍被迫下馬步戰，這正是宋軍以步卒結陣、以弩射壓的機會。吳玠的部署有三層：一是收攏散兵數千，退守扼住蜀道的要隘與和尚原，營壘依岩而築，無退路故無潰散之地；二是以弓弩結「弩陣」，依傍巖壁為壘，勁弓強弩輪番射擊，密集如雨，把來攻者可用的縱衝空間壓到最小；三是分遣小股奇兵夜行，專打金軍的糧道與側後，並預設伏兵於神塢一帶，等金軍疲憊退卻時收其潰卒。十月初九，完顏宗弼集兵數萬，架浮橋渡澠水，自寶雞連營三十里，把大軍攤成一條長線；宋軍不與其爭全線鋒芒，只以弩陣輪番消耗，等待其三日的疲敝。金人退兵時遭伏擊而大潰，宗弼中箭，騎兵在狹窄山路上無處展開，奔突之間自相衝蹈。這種守險、斷糧、待疲的節奏，與同年九月富平之戰宋軍在平原地區因指揮不力而全軍崩潰恰好相反：同樣一批兵，換了地形與打法，結果完全兩樣。
tacticsEn: The geography of the Hanchengyuan line decided the way the battle was fought. The road running from Dasan Pass and Xuxian led to Hanchengyuan, and it was the gate from Guanzhong into Sichuan: the official road was narrow, full of strange standing rock, with steep slopes and deep gullies on both sides, so that cavalry could make almost no progress there and the Jin were forced to dismount and fight on foot. That was precisely the opening for a Song infantry line pressing them with the crossbow. Wu Jie's arrangement had three parts. First, he gathered in the scattered soldiers, a few thousand men, fell back on the passes that closed the road into Sichuan and on Hanchengyuan, and built the camp against the rock, so that having no line of retreat there was no place for the army to come apart. Second, he formed the crossbow line, with the camp built against the cliff and strong bows and heavy crossbows firing in relays so densely that it was like rain, which compressed to the smallest the space a charge could use. Third, he sent out small parties of picked men by night, to work on the Jin supply line and their rear, and he posted ambushes at Shenwu, ready to gather the broken when the Jin withdrew exhausted. On the ninth day of the tenth month Wanyan Zongbi gathered tens of thousands, threw a floating bridge over the Min, and spread his camp thirty li from Baoji, flattening the great host into a single long line; the Song did not contest his front anywhere, and simply spent him with the crossbow line in relays, waiting for the exhaustion of his three days. When the Jin withdrew they were ambushed and broke, Zongbi was hit, and the horse had no room to deploy in the narrow mountain road, colliding with itself as it broke. This rhythm of holding the ground, cutting the supply and waiting for the enemy to tire is the exact opposite of the Song disaster at Fuping in the ninth month of the same year, where a much larger force in the open country came apart through bad command: the same soldiers, a different terrain and a different way of fighting, gave entirely different results.
data: 可核對的數字集中在幾處。紹興元年三月初八，烏鶻、折合率軍先抵和尚原北，金騎在窄隘多石之處下馬步行時遭宋軍夾擊，敗退黃牛一帶，遇大風雨，士氣大潰；三天之後，沛立攻箭箙關（今陝西千陽南）欲接應烏鶻、折合，又被中州防禦使楊政擊退。十月十月初九，完顏宗弼集兵數萬，架設浮橋渡過澠水，自寶雞連營三十里，與宋軍相持三日而疲，金軍退時遭伏擊大潰，宗弼身中兩箭，士卒被俘千餘人，粟與器甲被繳數以萬計；其後金軍再攻虛縣、仙人關等地又敗，退回鳳翔，入川之謀暫時收住。背景的數字屬於前一役：建炎四年（一一三〇年）九月富平之戰，宋軍人數數倍於金軍，因指揮不力而大敗，關中五路淪陷；吳玠、吳璘奉張浚之命收攏散兵數千，退守要隘。三十里連營是此役最關鍵的一個數字：營地拉得越長，粟、芻與柴水的運送線就越長，一旦被切斷，數萬人的消耗便無從接續，攻方反而被自己的縱深拖累。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked gather in a few places. On the eighth day of the third month of the first year of Shaoxing, Wuhu and Zhehe led their troops first to the north of Hanchengyuan, and when the Jin horse had to dismount and walk through the narrow stony ground they were caught between the Song lines and driven back towards Huangniu, where a great wind and rain broke their spirits. Three days later Peili attacked Jianfumen (south of present-day Qianyang in Shaanxi) in order to join Wuhu and Zhehe, and was beaten back in turn by Yang Zheng, Defender of Zhongzhou. On the ninth day of the tenth month Wanyan Zongbi gathered tens of thousands of men, threw a floating bridge over the Min, and drew his camp out for thirty li from Baoji; after three days of fighting he was worn out, and in the retreat his army was ambushed and broke up, Zongbi taking two arrows, more than a thousand of his men being taken prisoner, and millet and armour and weapons being captured in quantities counted in tens of thousands. Afterwards the Jin attacked Xuxian and Xianguan and were beaten again, and fell back to Fengxiang, so that the plan of entering Sichuan was set aside for the time. The figures behind the action belong to the previous battle: in the ninth month of the fourth year of Jianyan (1130) at Fuping the Song army, several times the strength of the Jin, was defeated through bad command and the five circuits of Guanzhong were lost; Wu Jie and Wu Lin, acting on Zhang Jun's orders, gathered up a few thousand scattered men and fell back on the passes. The camp of thirty li is the most significant figure of the action: the longer the line of camp, the longer the line of transport for millet, fodder, firewood and water, and once that is cut the consumption of tens of thousands of men cannot be renewed, so the attacker is weighed down by his own depth.
cause: 打起上來的起因有兩層。金方在江南受挫：建炎四年金軍南下攻淮西、江南不成，遂改走西線，企圖迂迴入蜀，把南宋朝廷在江淮的正面壓力引向秦蜀山道，消滅偏安的政權。金軍在富平一役全勝，關中五路盡失，進逼四川，和尚原正卡在關中通往蜀道的咽喉上，成為金軍入川非取不可的一點，這是金廷的算盤。宋方則是被逼防守：朝廷以張浚攝川陝宣撫使，卻把主力放在江淮與荊襄，關中只留吳玠、吳璘兄弟與數千散兵；有人勸吳玠退守漢中，他不肯，理由寫得很明白——此處可以壘壁固守，敵人越過去也算計不到後方，守住這裡就是守住蜀地。同一時期宋方內部還出事：吳璘誣陷川陝名將曲端，曲端下獄被殺，一批熟悉關中山勢的將校失去主張，而援軍遠在數千里之外，吳玠只能靠地形、靠弩陣、靠夜襲去補兵力與指揮的不足。金軍的顧慮同樣具體：三十里連營的糧秣全靠後方輸送，時間拖得越久，糧道就越危險，遠征一旦受阻，撤退與再攻都無所憑藉。
causeEn: There were two layers to the occasion of the fighting. The Jin had been checked in the south of the river: in the fourth year of Jianyan their advance into Huai west and Jiangnan came to nothing, so they turned to the western line with the intention of going round into Sichuan, drawing the pressure of the Southern Song court away from the Huai and the river country and into the Qin and Sichuan roads, and destroying the regime that had taken refuge in the south. Having won outright at Fuping and taken the five circuits of Guanzhong, they pressed towards Sichuan, and Hanchengyuan lay exactly across the throat of the road from Guanzhong into Sichuan; it was a point the Jin court had to take, and that was the arithmetic behind it. The Song, for their part, were defending because they had to. The court gave Zhang Jun the acting command over Sichuan and Shaanxi but kept the main strength in the Huai and in Jingchu, leaving in Guanzhong only the brothers Wu Jie and Wu Lin with a few thousand scattered men. When others urged Wu Jie to fall back to Hanzhong he refused, and the reason is set out plainly: the place can be walled in and held, and if the enemy goes past it they cannot calculate what is behind it, so to hold this spot is to hold Sichuan. There was also trouble inside the Song in the same period: Wu Lin charged Qu Duan, the famous commander of the Sichuan and Shaanxi region, and Qu Duan was thrown into prison and put to death, a group of officers who knew the mountains of Guanzhong lost their voice, and the reinforcements were thousands of li away, so that Wu Jie could only make up for his shortage of men and of command with the ground, with the crossbow line, and with night attacks. The Jin's own anxiety was just as concrete: the grain of a camp thirty li long came entirely from the rear, the longer the time dragged on the more dangerous the supply line became, and if the march stalled there was nothing on which to base a retreat or a second attack.
impact: 這一戰的結果改變了秦蜀一線的攻守格局。金軍入川的計劃在和尚原折斷，退回鳳翔，宋軍則從富平敗後的崩潰中重新站住腳，在關中保住了一個可以屯兵、可以練弩、可以練馬的根據地。吳玠以數千散兵擋住數萬金騎，名字自此重於西南；朝廷把川陝防務交給吳氏兄弟經營，吳玠在和尚原、仙人關一線整頓營壘、編練弩陣，把關口一帶的地形吃透，兩年後在仙人關再以弩陣與長槍結陣擊退金軍，兵法上承自此役。對整個宋金戰局而言，和尚原是一次成功的阻滯：金軍的進攻重心被釘在西北，江淮一線的壓力隨之減輕，紹興四年金廷三路南侵時，才把主要兵力放在淮東與襄漢。就兵器史而言，這一戰把十字弩的長處與短處同時擺清楚：在無路可退的岩壁壘前，弩的穿透力、精度與不受體力波動影響的穩定性，遠勝手開之弓；但它的裝填遲緩意味著它必須依附地形與陣位，一旦被拖進自己沒有退路的消耗戰，或者在開闊地被騎兵合圍，弩陣就會由倚仗變成拖累。和尚原之所以能夠成立，正因為這件兵器被放在了正確的位置上。
impactEn: The result of the action changed the balance of attack and defence on the Qin and Sichuan line. The Jin plan of entering Sichuan was broken at Hanchengyuan and they fell back to Fengxiang, while the Song recovered their footing after the collapse at Fuping and kept a base in Guanzhong in which troops could be quartered and horses and crossbows could be drilled. Wu Jie had held tens of thousands of Jin horse with a few thousand scattered men, and from that moment his name carried weight in the southwest. The court entrusted the defence of Sichuan and Shaanxi to the Wu brothers, and along the line from Hanchengyuan to Xianguan Wu Jie put his camp in order and drilled his crossbow line, learning the ground of the passes thoroughly; two years later at Xianguan he broke the Jin again with a line of crossbows and spears, and the art behind that came from this battle. For the war as a whole, Hanchengyuan was a successful check: the Jin thrust was nailed down in the northwest, the pressure on the Huai eased, and only in the fourth year of Shaoxing, when the Jin court sent three columns south, was the main weight of their army put on the Huai east and on Xiangyang. As to the history of weapons, this battle set the strengths and the weaknesses of the crossbow side by side: in a camp built against the rock with no line of retreat, the penetration, the accuracy and the steadiness of a crossbow, which do not vary with the strength of the man drawing it, are far better than those of a hand bow; but its slow reload means that it has to lean on the ground and on its place in the line, and once it is drawn into a war of attrition in which it has no way back, or surrounded by horse in open country, the crossbow line changes from an asset into a drag. Hanchengyuan was possible precisely because this weapon was put in the right place.
result: 結果是金軍攻勢在和尚原被挫斷。十月初九完顏宗弼集兵數萬來攻，三日之後精疲而退，退路上遭宋軍伏擊大潰，宗弼身中兩箭，奔突而走；宋軍俘金軍千餘人，繳獲粟米與器甲數以萬計。接著金軍再攻虛縣、仙人關等地仍然失利，被迫退回鳳翔，短時間內再無入川之舉。蜀道與關中的門戶重新握在宋軍手中，吳玠的軍職隨之晉升，史載其後加檢校少保、鎮西軍節度使，與弟吳璘分守蜀口，形成後來秦蜀防禦的骨架，宋廷的西北防線由崩潰邊緣重新立住。對這件弩來說，這場戰役給出的答案很簡單：它不是靠射程贏的，也不是靠射速，而是靠位置——在只容數人並肩的窄道與岩壁前，把十數床弩排成可以輪番射擊的射界，密度遠超對方騎兵的機動力所能應付。金軍的問題從來不是能不能衝，而是馬能不能站穩、能不能轉身、能不能在亂石之間找到衝鋒的縱幅。
resultEn: The result was that the Jin offensive was broken at Hanchengyuan. On the ninth day of the tenth month Wanyan Zongbi came up with tens of thousands of men; after three days he was worn out and withdrew, and on the way back he was ambushed and broke up, Zongbi taking two arrows and getting away in disorder. The Song took more than a thousand of the Jin prisoner and captured millet, armour and weapons in quantities counted in tens of thousands. The Jin then attacked Xuxian and Xianguan and were beaten again, and were driven back to Fengxiang, so that for some time there was no further move into Sichuan. The gate of the road into Sichuan and of Guanzhong was once more in Song hands; Wu Jie's commands were raised accordingly, the record has it that he was given the additional title of Inspector of the Household and the Military Governor of Zhenxi, and he and his brother Wu Lin held the mouth of the Sichuan roads between them, forming the skeleton of the later Qin and Sichuan defence, and the court's north-western line was re-established just after it had come close to collapse. As for the crossbow on the card, the answer this battle gives is a simple one: it won neither by range nor by rate of fire, but by position. Set a dozen crossbows in a line in a narrow lane or against a cliff where only a few men can stand abreast, and give them a field of fire they can shoot in relays, and their density is far beyond anything the manoeuvre of the opposing horse can absorb. The Jin problem was never whether they could charge, but whether the horse could stand, could turn, and could find room to charge among the broken rock.
